items_flat.title_en: OpenAI starts EU text watermarking, with detector limited to researchers
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 啟動歐盟文字浮水印，偵測器先限研究人員
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is expanding content provenance to text to meet the EU AI Act. API customers worldwide can opt in today for select models; watermarking stays off by default. Over the coming weeks, eligible ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU will carry an invisible textGrain watermark. The detector is initially limited to approved researchers, and OpenAI says short, edited, translated, or math-heavy text is much harder to detect.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，為符合歐盟《AI 法案》，內容溯源將擴及文字。全球 API 客戶今日起可對指定模型選擇加入，預設關閉。未來數週，歐盟符合條件的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 文字將加入不可見的 textGrain 浮水印。偵測器先只開放核准研究人員；官方指出短文、改寫、翻譯與數學內容明顯較難偵測。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a compliance rollout, not a solved provenance system: OpenAI’s own tests show synonym edits can collapse detection. Restricting the detector avoids a public false-positive tool, but it also means most users still cannot check a passage.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是合規部署，不是已解決的溯源技術：官方測試顯示同義改寫會讓偵測率大幅下降。偵測器不公開可避免誤判工具外流，但也代表多數人仍無法自行查核一段文字。
items_flat.quote: In the EU, we’ll start watermarking eligible text from ChatGPT and Codex over the coming weeks to comply with the EU AI Act.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在歐盟，我們將於未來數週開始為符合條件的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 文字加上浮水印，以遵守歐盟《AI 法案》。

items_flat.title_en: Nvidia-backed Reflection unveils Beam, a 501B open-weight model
items_flat.title_zh: 輝達支持的 Reflection 公布 501B 開源權重模型 Beam
items_flat.summary_en: Reflection AI introduced Beam, its first open-weight model: a text-only mixture-of-experts with 501 billion total parameters and 23 billion active, a 1 million token context, and pretraining on 23.8 trillion tokens. The company says it is competitive with Z.ai’s GLM-5.2 and approaching Qwen 3.8-Max on coding and agent tasks, at lower inference compute. Weights, the technical report, and model card are due later this month; early access is sign-up only.
items_flat.summary_zh: Reflection AI 推出首個開源權重模型 Beam：純文字混合專家，總參數 5010 億、每步啟動 230 億，上下文 100 萬 token，預訓練 23.8 兆 token。公司稱其在程式與代理任務上可與 Z.ai GLM-5.2 競爭，並接近 Qwen 3.8-Max，推論算力較低。權重、技術報告與模型卡本月稍晚釋出，目前僅能登記早期使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Beam is a Western open-weight answer aimed at Chinese models, but the performance claims are the lab’s own and the weights are not downloadable yet. Nvidia backing and prior Colossus 2 capacity make the compute story real; independent evals are still missing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Beam 是針對中國開源模型的西方回應，但成績是實驗室自述，權重也還不能下載。輝達支持與先前 Colossus 2 算力協議讓算力故事成立，獨立評測仍缺。
items_flat.quote: We are introducing Beam, Reflection’s first open-weight model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 Beam，這是 Reflection 的第一個開源權重模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI tests visual ChatGPT ads and expands measurement partners
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 測試 ChatGPT 圖像廣告並擴大量測合作
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it will test a new visual ad format during image generation in ChatGPT, clearly labeled and kept separate from the generated image. US testing with an initial advertiser group starts later this month. It also expanded conversion and attribution integrations, including LiveRamp, AppsFlyer, and Triple Whale, and brand-suitability pilots with DoubleVerify and IAS. OpenAI says ads do not influence answers.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示將在 ChatGPT 生圖流程測試新的圖像廣告格式，廣告會清楚標示並與生成圖片分開。美國首批廣告主測試本月稍晚開始。公司同時擴大轉換與歸因整合，包括 LiveRamp、AppsFlyer、Triple Whale，並與 DoubleVerify、IAS 進行品牌適配試點。官方稱廣告不影響回答。
items_flat.analysis_en: The format change puts ads next to a creative action, which is a larger surface than text placements, but the test is still US-only and later this month. Partner case studies are not independent audits of answer independence.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 新格式把廣告放進創作動作旁，曝光面比純文字更大，但測試仍限美國且本月稍晚才開始。合作夥伴案例不能視為回答不受影響的獨立稽核。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing a new visual ad format in ChatGPT, expanding our measurement tools and partnerships, and developing new ways to understand brand suitability.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在 ChatGPT 推出新的圖像廣告格式，擴大量測工具與合作，並發展新方法來理解品牌適配。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI adds in-product HIPAA BAA flow for eligible API orgs
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 為合格 API 組織加入線上 HIPAA BAA 流程
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s API changelog for Oct 5 says eligible organization admins can accept a standard Business Associate Agreement and enable HIPAA compliance support in Organization settings. Coverage still depends on eligibility, covered services, and configuration such as modified retention. Separately, billing for the already released GPT-Rosalind research model began on Oct 5.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI API 更新日誌寫道，10 月 5 日起合格組織管理員可在組織設定中接受標準業務夥伴協議並啟用 HIPAA 支援。實際涵蓋仍取決於資格、受覆蓋服務與修改保留等設定。另外，已釋出的 GPT-Rosalind 研究模型自 10 月 5 日開始計費。
items_flat.analysis_en: The practical change is contracting friction, not a new clinical model. Healthcare buyers still have to confirm which endpoints and ChatGPT plans are actually eligible before sending PHI.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 實質改變是簽約摩擦降低，不是新的臨床模型。醫療客戶在傳送受保護健康資訊前，仍須確認哪些端點與 ChatGPT 方案真正受涵蓋。
items_flat.quote: Admins of eligible organizations can now accept the standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and enable HIPAA compliance support for their organization.
items_flat.quote_zh: 合格組織的管理員現在可以接受標準業務夥伴協議（BAA），並為其組織啟用 HIPAA 合規支援。

brief_en: OpenAI started EU text watermarking prep and opt-in API provenance, and expanded ChatGPT ads with a visual format and measurement partners. It also opened an in-product HIPAA BAA flow. Reflection unveiled Beam, a 501B open-weight coding model; weights are not out yet. No new flagship from Anthropic, Google, Meta, or xAI.
brief_zh: OpenAI 啟動歐盟文字浮水印與 API 選擇加入，並擴大 ChatGPT 廣告量測。API 也可線上簽署 HIPAA BAA。Reflection 公布 501B 開源權重模型 Beam，權重尚未釋出。Anthropic、Google、Meta、xAI 無新旗艦。
